discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the harness-eval run_02.1 organic bug-fix/recovery round as a distinct evidence design. Six run_02 repositories sharing the same malformed/truncated XML defect resume from their own pre-fix boundary, receive source-defined bug reports without sealed tests, and are verified by the frozen full suite plus a sealed three-test fix addendum. W1 records recovery outcomes and environment deviations without repair-quality or causal interpretation.

protocol_events.effect: GitHub Copilot MCP availability changed during the fix field. An early Phoenix fix attempt lacking its intended spine was voided, its work preserved separately, staging reset to pre-fix, and the valid Phoenix rerun proceeded after restoring Phoenix approval. klams/korg remained deliberately unapproved for the Copilot fix subfield.

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The run_02 build cell already passed the frozen build verification 26/26 and did not share the defect that triggered the fix round; the source therefore did not run a fix cell. W1 does not fabricate a recovery observation.

The source explicitly voided the attempt because the intended Phoenix MCP spine was unavailable, preserved the work separately, reset the staging repository to pre-fix, and reran under the restored intended spine.
Those are source analysis and evaluative interpretation. W1 preserves the underlying recovery outcomes, timings, and environment conditions only.
